offering_description.value: Develops and sells software for building, deploying and managing business applications and data infrastructure. Customers are mainly enterprises, software vendors and IT organizations. Delivered as licenses and cloud subscriptions, with support and maintenance.

primary_products.value: application development software; digital experience and content management software; data connectivity and integration software; file transfer software; network monitoring software

primary_services.value: technical support and maintenance; consulting and training; managed cloud hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises, independent software vendors, IT and DevOps teams, managed service providers; B2G: government agencies using its software

end_markets.value: enterprise software; financial services; healthcare; public sector; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: cloud and term subscriptions to software products; licensing or royalties: perpetual and term software licenses, including OEM licenses; service fees: maintenance, support, consulting and training
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and owns software platforms sold to enterprises, software vendors and IT teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: application development, content management, data connectivity, file transfer, and observability and security software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams; partners / resellers: resellers, OEM partners and system integrators; online: web-based purchase and cloud marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus data privacy and security rules such as GDPR
